ordinance.ordinance_citation: San Francisco Administrative Code Chapter 19B (Acquisition of Surveillance Technology)
ordinance.oversight_body: Committee on Information Technology (COIT) / Privacy and Surveillance Advisory Board

documents.text: Biannual Surveillance Technology Inventory Report, March 2, 2026. The San Francisco Administrative Code via Chapter 19B: Acquisition of Surveillance Technology requires COIT staff to maintain an inventory of all surveillance technologies that departments plan to buy or are using, and to publish a biannual report on the inventory's status. The report includes the name of each technology in the inventory, a general technology category description, the department using or planning to use the technology, and information about where that technology is in the policy creation and approval process. As of March 1, 2026, 66% of surveillance technologies in use or in the process of being procured have a surveillance technology policy approved by the Board of Supervisors, 7% have a draft policy that has been reviewed by the COIT Privacy and Surveillance Advisory Board, 1% is represented by technologies seeking to be procured, and 26% are surveillance technologies currently in use without a policy.

reported_compliance.non_compliance_finding: 26% of surveillance technologies in use have no approved policy (as of 2026-03-01)
